core_meaning.primary_meaning: Siti is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Lady”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Siti corresponds to the Arabic form سِيتِي (Arabic سِتّ (sitt, lady)). Its core sense is siti; lady (indonesian form). Siti is the Indonesian/Malay form of Arabic سِتّ (sitt), meaning 'lady'. It is widely used as a female given name, often before a name such as Siti Aisyah.
